      io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.poweredup.HubPort
      Kept for one compatibility release. Use PoweredUpPort for the external ports A to D, and BuiltInSensor for the Technic Hub's built-in sensors; the RemotePoweredUpHub overloads that take a HubPort delegate to them.
